summary: MGT Capital Investments filed an 8-K disclosing a private placement of up to $500,000 of common stock at $0.001 per share to accredited investors under Rule 506(b). As of filing, $150,000 has been closed with three investors. The offering rolls through July 31, 2026, extendable to August 30, 2026. Proceeds fund working capital. This is a routine capital-raising event, not a special situation.
